newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania to send peacekeeping unit to Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Albania to send peacekeeping unit to Croatia.

text.p: The Albanian parliament passed a law on Thursday which would allow the armed forces of the former communist state to serve in peacekeeping missions abroad for the first time.
A Defence Ministry official said a unit of 50 troops would leave for Zadar in Croatia on September 9 to serve alongside German troops in the NATO-led peace implementation force (IFOR) for Bosnia,
Albania, which shares a border with rump Yugoslavia, is seeking NATO membership and is an active member of the Partnership for Peace programme.

State Secretary of Defence Leonard Demi said the new law showed Albania was committed to the principles and objectives of Partnership for Peace, which was the main route for gaining NATO membership, the state-run ATA news agency reported.
